payload.title: Non-command statusLine has no badge surface; deploy/index.ts comment stale
payload.body: Live on claude 2.1.285: a statusLine whose type is not command is a Settings Error and the whole settings.json is skipped, so no status line runs and nothing in install's outputs can show the badge; the only in-session surface is a one-time SessionStart systemMessage from an agent-frontmatter hook (needs adapters/claude/render.ts, outside this unit), which scrolls away. Also packages/forge/src/deploy/index.ts comment at :154-156 still says 'wrapped only on request' (outside this unit's outputs).
